prompts.praca_verde: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: final background for a cozy mystery 2D SIDE-SCROLLING pixel-art game. Create one extremely wide landscape scene of Praça Verde, a fictional neighborhood square in Rio de Janeiro in 1890. Detailed hand-crafted-looking pixel art with crisp square pixels, warm amber sunlight, sage and dark bottle greens, terracotta and parchment tones, expressive plants and nineteenth-century Brazilian colonial facades in the distant background. Entire scene is viewed straight from the side at pedestrian eye level, designed for a platform-style side-scrolling game, NOT an overhead view, NOT isometric. A broad leafy square, low trees, iron benches, a modest bandstand far behind, a simple newspaper kiosk, subtle distant hills. Make the bottom ONE SIXTH of the image a continuous nearly horizontal broad stone-paved walkway in the foreground across the entire image; the walkway top is exactly at five sixths of image height, so standing character sprites can place their feet on it. Leave the front walkway unobstructed and empty so player and NPC sprites can be overlaid. No people, animals, character sprites, UI, letters, words, signage text, logos or watermark. Cohesive charming retro pixel-art game atmosphere, slight literary mystery mood, readable silhouettes, horizontal environment. Preferred panorama aspect ratio 3:1 or wider, with generous lateral environmental detail.
prompts.cabana_capitu: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: final background for a cozy nineteenth-century Brazilian mystery SIDE-SCROLLING pixel-art game. Create a very wide horizontal panorama of Capitu's wooden consultation cottage and garden, a fictional setting in Rio de Janeiro in 1890. Same warm detailed crisp pixel-art art direction as a charming handcrafted retro village game: sage and bottle greens, warm ochre, terracotta, pale parchment highlights and weathered wood. STRAIGHT SIDE VIEW from pedestrian height for a 2D platform game, not overhead or isometric. A modest attractive timber cottage with red clay tiled roof, shaded veranda, potted ferns and flowering plants, a visible consultation table, a few candles, cards and a book as small objects, plus mature vegetation and distant muted colonial facades. Intimate, dignified and welcoming, no sinister caricature. Cottage mainly in the middle section with garden continuing laterally; keep clear space in front. Across the bottom ONE SIXTH of the image place a completely continuous and nearly horizontal stone-and-earth walkway where separate game sprites will stand; the walkway is unobstructed and empty. Detailed environment above it. No people, animals, figures, character sprites, monsters, UI, words, letters, text, logos or watermark. Wide aspect ratio 3:1, cohesive low-resolution pixel-art clusters, readable silhouettes, subtle literary mystery atmosphere.
prompts.casa_verde: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: final wide background for a charming nineteenth-century Brazilian mystery SIDE-SCROLLING pixel-art game. Scene: Casa Verde, a fictional institutional house for medical observation in Rio de Janeiro in 1890. VERY WIDE 3:1 landscape panorama, STRAIGHT SIDE VIEW from pedestrian eye level for a 2D side-scrolling game, never overhead/isometric. Crisp handcrafted-looking pixel-art clusters, consistent with a warm cozy village game: dark bottle-green shutters and doors, sage-green walls, pale stone, terracotta roof, warm amber light, subtle muted blues in distant hills. A dignified imposing green colonial medical institution with tall windows, central arch entrance, wrought-iron boundary gate and a small orderly garden. A few botanical and scientific objects visible through a reception window, no modern machines. Institution spans central area, leafy walls and architecture continuing laterally. Across the bottom SIXTH of the image, a fully continuous nearly horizontal broad paved footpath, with enough clear space above it to overlay separate human sprites; this foreground walkway is EMPTY and traversable, nothing blocks the front lane. Atmospheric but humane and sober, no horror gore or caricatures. No people, patients, animals, sprites, letters, writing, signs, UI, logo, watermark. Low-resolution game pixel aesthetic rather than painterly brush strokes, no blur.
prompts.cafe_largo: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: final panorama background for a cozy mystery 2D SIDE-SCROLLING pixel-art game set in Rio de Janeiro in 1890. Location: the fictional Café do Largo, a sociable corner café. Very wide 3:1 horizontal panorama, straight side elevation at pedestrian height, suited to horizontal platform-game movement, NOT top-down, NOT isometric. Crisp square-pixel clusters and rich handcrafted retro game detail; terracotta tiled rooftops, honey ochre plaster, bottle-green wooden doors, burgundy awning, dark wood, tropical green plants and amber afternoon light; hazy blue hills distant. A modest elegant café with open entrance and visible wooden counter, porcelain coffee cups, wicker chairs and a few small round tables placed BEHIND the walkable foreground lane; surrounding colonial townhouse facades extend the street. Empty front paving at the bottom one sixth of the image, continuous level stone walkway across full width, sufficient vertical room for separate game sprites, no obstacles in the very front lane. Small atmospheric gas lamps, balcony ironwork, potted ferns. No people or animals, no character silhouettes, no sprites, no food mascot, no UI, no text or letters on signs or awnings, no logos or watermark. Inviting but quietly mysterious, consistent with a retro Brazilian literary detective game.
prompts.cais_lanternas: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: final panorama background for a cozy mystery 2D SIDE-SCROLLING pixel-art game set in Rio de Janeiro in 1890. Location: fictional Cais das Lanternas, a waterfront promenade and working pier at early evening. Very wide 3:1 landscape panorama, STRAIGHT SIDE VIEW from pedestrian height for horizontal platform-game movement, NOT top-down, NOT isometric. Rich crisp square-pixel clusters with handcrafted retro village-game charm: cool muted teal water and distant blue mountains, sage vegetation, warm honey amber gas lanterns, weathered dark wood, terracotta tiled warehouses and old pale plaster. Large calm bay with a few anchored nineteenth-century sailboats in the middle distance, stone quay wall behind a broad level walkable foreground promenade, rope coils and mooring bollards BEHIND the front lane, simple warehouse facade toward one end, a few wooden crates aside. The bottom one SIXTH is a completely continuous unobstructed nearly horizontal stone walkway across the full width; separate human character sprites will stand on it. Clear atmosphere for investigation, welcoming and slightly mysterious. No people, animals, embedded character sprites or silhouettes, no modern ships, vehicles, electric lights, UI, letters, words, text, logos or watermark. Pixel art must be coherent with sunny colonial village scenes, but the dusk gaslight gives this location its identity.
prompts.city: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: illustrated travel-map background for a cozy pixel-art detective game in a fictional neighborhood of Rio de Janeiro in 1890. Create a landscape map roughly 3:2 aspect ratio, designed to receive FIVE clickable location labels from the game interface. Decorative overhead illustrated neighborhood map, crisp handcrafted square-pixel art, warm parchment tan ground, sage and dark green vegetation, terracotta roofs and muted teal water. Layout EXACTLY five recognizable destination landmarks joined by small winding paths: a leafy public square with a small bandstand in the CENTER; a small wooden cottage with lush garden in the UPPER LEFT; a larger green colonial institutional building in the UPPER RIGHT; a corner café with burgundy awning and tiny outdoor tables in the LOWER LEFT; a stone waterfront quay and warehouse with boats on water in the LOWER RIGHT. Surround with a handful of minor small roof shapes, tropical trees and distant stylized hills so it feels like a coherent fictional neighborhood, while those five landmarks remain spaced and unmistakable. Compact ornamental map border in restrained wood/aged-paper style. No text, letters, numbers, labels, title, compass letters, people, UI buttons, logos or watermark. No modern buildings or vehicles. Map is fictional and need not be geographically accurate. Leave breathing room around each landmark for HTML labels overlaid later.
